title: Maple Hollow Rising Revisited
premise: Marine biologist Dominic Okonkwo has spent a decade treating love like a lab protocol: controlled, contained, never fully invested. When a freak snowstorm traps him in the Vermont inn of Maple Hollow with his estranged best friend Amara and her ex-fiancé Julian — the two people whose broken engagement he accidentally caused in their twenties — old truths thaw faster than the roads. As the storm isolates the town, Dominic must finally confess his decade-old secret and choose between protecting Amara's loyalty to Julian and claiming the love he's denied himself. The story ends with the storm breaking: Amara chooses truth over history, Julian finds his own grace, and Dominic learns the heart isn't containable after all.
about_author: L. M. Sterling is the pen name of a former research assistant turned novelist who writes small-town romances about scientists who think they can out-study their own hearts. Sterling lives between coastal field stations and snowy mountain towns, always with a notebook full of tide charts and half-finished love stories.

chapters.title: Counting Turtles
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. In the Florida Keys, Dominic catalogs sea turtle nests with meticulous detachment, narrating his philosophy that the heart is a trainable muscle. A letter from Maple Hollow's innkeeper invites him north for a winter festival honoring his late mentor. Emotional beat: controlled calm masking avoidance.

chapters.title: The Invitation He Should Have Burned
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. He rereads the invitation and the memory it drags up: Amara, Julian, one night ten years ago. His sister teases that he's running from a place, not a person. He books the flight anyway. Emotional beat: dread disguised as scientific curiosity.

chapters.title: Snow at the Edge of Town
chapters.summary: Amara's POV. Amara restores the inn she and Julian once dreamed of owning together, preparing for the festival while the forecast turns ominous. She doesn't know Dominic is coming. Emotional beat: bittersweet pride in a life built from wreckage.

chapters.title: Arrivals
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Dominic reaches Maple Hollow just as the first heavy snow falls — and walks into the inn's kitchen to find Amara and Julian, back for the festival, frozen mid-argument. Three plates, three chairs, one unbearable silence. Emotional beat: shock curdling into inevitability.

chapters.title: Stranded
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. The road closes; the festival is postponed; the three are stuck together with the inn's quirky staff as reluctant witnesses. Old rhythms resurface — Julian's jokes, Amara's deflections, Dominic's careful neutrality. Emotional beat: claustrophobic politeness.

chapters.title: What the Storm Digs Up
chapters.summary: Amara's POV. Amara finds an old photo box while restocking the attic: the three of them at twenty-five, before everything broke. She wonders why Dominic vanished afterward and why Julian never asked. Emotional beat: grief sharpening into questions.

chapters.title: The Muscle Memory of Friendship
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Dominic and Julian repair the generator together, trading the easy banter of old friends until Julian says, quietly, 'You disappeared too.' Dominic deflects with turtle facts. Emotional beat: guilt wearing competence as armor.

chapters.title: Julian's Version
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. Alone on the porch, Julian admits to himself the engagement was already dying before it ended — and that part of him was relieved when it did. He watches Amara laugh with Dominic and feels something unexpected: not jealousy, but curiosity. Emotional beat: rueful self-honesty.

chapters.title: Turtle Lessons
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. During a blackout, Dominic tells the gathered staff and Amara how hatchlings must struggle unaided or they never grow strong enough — then realizes Amara is staring at him like she's heard the metaphor before, aimed at himself. Emotional beat: intimacy sneaking past defenses.

chapters.title: The Almost
chapters.summary: Amara's POV. Candlelight, wine, a conversation that tilts. Amara and Dominic nearly kiss — and she pulls back, furious at herself, because something about his guilt feels wrong, unfinished. Emotional beat: longing tangled with suspicion.

chapters.title: Loyalty Is a Kind of Debt
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Dominic drafts a confession text a dozen times and deletes each one. Flashback chapter: ten years ago, the night before the wedding, when Amara kissed him and he fled rather than betray Julian. Emotional beat: the weight of a decade-old silence.

chapters.title: The Innkeeper Knows Everything
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. The innkeeper, Rosa, who inherited the mentor's letters, reveals the festival was partly meant to reunite the three friends — the mentor's last wish. The trio confronts the fact they've been gently manipulated by a dead man's hope. Emotional beat: tender indignation.

chapters.title: Whiteout
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. The worst of the storm hits; power fails completely; a pipe bursts. Working side by side through the night, the trio's teamwork feels dangerously like family again. Emotional beat: found family reassembling under pressure.

chapters.title: Julian Asks the Question
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. Over emergency lanterns, Julian asks Dominic point-blank why he really left ten years ago. Dominic lies badly. Julian lets it go — but not kindly. Emotional beat: the trap closing.

chapters.title: Amara Remembers First
chapters.summary: Amara's POV. Amara pieces it together alone: the timing, Dominic's guilt, the almost-kiss that felt like déjà vu. She confronts him in the snow-covered garden, demanding the truth. Emotional beat: heartbreak arriving ahead of explanation.

chapters.title: The Confession
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. In the cold, Dominic confesses everything: the kiss, the flight, the decade of counting turtles instead of facing her. He tells her he won't ask her to choose — but he's done lending pieces of his heart. Emotional beat: raw, terrifying honesty.

chapters.title: What Loyalty Actually Means
chapters.summary: Julian's POV. Julian, having overheard, walks into the garden — and instead of rage, offers release: 'You weren't betraying me. You were both betraying yourselves.' He admits the marriage would have failed regardless. Emotional beat: unexpected grace.

chapters.title: Running Out of Time
chapters.summary: Amara's POV. Roads reopen; Julian leaves first, with a handshake for Dominic and a real goodbye for Amara. But a job offer in Alaska forces Amara to decide within days whether Maple Hollow — and Dominic — are home or habit. Emotional beat: urgency replacing fear.

chapters.title: The Festival, Finally
chapters.summary: Ensemble POV. The town holds the delayed winter festival; the mentor's letters are read aloud, including one addressed to Dominic: 'Stop studying your heart. Use it.' The whole town watches Amara and Dominic orbit each other. Emotional beat: communal warmth, private stakes.

chapters.title: Risking the Whole Heart
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. On the frozen lake where they skated at twenty-five, Dominic lays it all down: no protocols, no containment, all of it risked. Amara answers with the truth of her own — she chose loyalty to a ghost when the living man was standing there. Emotional beat: surrender without defeat.

chapters.title: Hatchlings
chapters.summary: Amara's POV. Spring. Amara declines Alaska and co-founds a conservation program with Dominic at Maple Hollow; Julian sends a postcard from Lisbon, genuinely happy. The found family of the inn becomes literal partnership. Emotional beat: quiet joy taking root.

chapters.title: Rising
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Closing mirror of chapter one: on a Vermont riverbank, Dominic releases rehabilitated turtles with Amara beside him, no longer counting, simply present. The heart, he concedes, was never a muscle to train — only a door to open. Emotional beat: earned peace.
